about: CONTROL Resonant's six combo finishers. Each row becomes the built-in skill of one Aberrant form, borrowing the animation of an Elden Ring skill.

rows.name: Concussive Beatdown
rows.description: A string of quick blows that pile on stagger.

rows.name: Uppercut Surge
rows.description: Hook the enemy and hurl them upward.

rows.name: Wide Edge
rows.description: One spinning sweep that strikes everything nearby.

rows.name: Split Pivot
rows.description: The blades split and pivot into a circular cut.

rows.name: Split Orbit
rows.description: The weapon breaks into an orbiting blade that hits all around.

rows.name: Spin Edge
rows.description: A continuous spin that shreds all close foes.
